# unique_table_alias

<!-- Generated by xtask. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Summary:** Requires table aliases to be unique within a statement.

**Category:** `correctness`

**Editor default:** `live`

**Default level:** `warn`

**Fixable:** no

## Rationale

Reused table aliases make column qualification ambiguous to readers.

## Configuration

```toml
[lints]
unique_table_alias = { level = "warn" }
```

### Options

No options.

## Examples

**Anti-pattern:**

```sql
SELECT t.id FROM foo AS t JOIN bar AS t ON t.id = t.id
```

**Best practice:**

```sql
SELECT f.id FROM foo AS f JOIN bar AS b ON f.id = b.id
```
